entries.en:
Lisette commends your service on House Valentione's behalf, her ancestral senses telling her that your deeds have provided no small degree of solace to those lost in love. To reward you for your efforts, she deigns to offer you the opportunity to find love of your own. Trade with a  to obtain two types of chocolate─bitter and pure heart─and deliver the pair of confections to Lisette.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

entries.en: Lisette gladly accepts your chocolates, seemingly quite relieved that the Valentione's Day festivities may now draw gradually to a close. For all of her efforts on behalf of lovers the realm over, it would appear that the fiery Ishgardian has had considerably less fortune in her own romantic endeavors...
entries.fr: Lisette accepte de bon cœur vos chocolats, semblant soulagée que les festivités de la Valention touchent à leur fin. Malgré tous ses efforts pour aider les amoureux du monde entier, il semble que l'Ishgardaise passionnée ne soit pas très heureuse en amour...
